encoding: Query-major UInt32 little-endian squared L2; UInt32.max marks invalid/unrun. Row hashes use the same encoding. Top ten order is (distance, original row ID).
interpretation: GPU computes dots; CPU reconstructs and selects. Descriptive times only; RAW JSON serialization excluded, outer process interval includes it. Explicit memory bound includes conservatively simultaneous input staging and output serialization; excludes framework allocations, metadata and file caches. Device counters are global samples, not peaks or free RAM.
